translations.web: Therefore you shall love Yahweh your God, and keep his instructions, his statutes, his ordinances, and his commandments, always.
translations.bsb: You shall therefore love the LORD your God and always keep His charge, His statutes, His ordinances, and His commandments.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
translations.asv: Therefore thou shalt love Jehovah thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his ordinances, and his commandments, alway.
